basis.governing_question: Where and why do patient waiting times arise at Norte Hospitals Group's three hospitals?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish where and why patients wait across the three hospitals and how long the waits run.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Does the medical director accept the waiting-time findings as the basis for action?

workstreams.name: Waiting-time baseline
workstreams.answers: How long do patients wait at each of the three hospitals, and how do the waits vary?
activities: Collect operational data on waiting times at each hospital
Calculate waits by step, hospital and period
Check data quality with the people who record it

workstreams.name: Patient journey mapping
workstreams.answers: At which steps of the patient journey do patients queue at each hospital?
activities: Interview staff and patients on where waits occur
Observe patient flow at each hospital
Map the steps patients go through at each hospital

workstreams.name: Causes of waiting
workstreams.answers: Why do waits arise at those steps, and which operational factors explain them?
activities: Test explanations for waits against operational data
Interview the people who schedule and deliver care
Review documents that set how care is scheduled

workstreams.name: Cross-hospital findings
workstreams.answers: How do waits and their causes compare across the three hospitals, and what do the findings show?
activities: Compare waits and causes across the three hospitals
Test findings with staff at each hospital
Prepare the final readout for the medical director

deliverables.name: Waiting-time baseline by hospital, step and period
Patient journey maps with queue points by hospital
Causes of waiting by step, tested against data
Cross-hospital findings readout for the medical director

events.label: Kick-off
events.purpose: Start the diagnostic and secure access
events.decision: Will the sponsor open access to waiting-time data and staff at all three hospitals?
agenda: Align on the diagnostic objective and the three hospitals in scope
Review the data and people needed for the baseline and journey maps
Decide on access to waiting-time data and staff

events.label: Check-in: causes of waiting
events.purpose: Review evidence and set findings focus
events.decision: Which tested causes of waiting should the cross-hospital readout detail?
agenda: Present the waiting-time baseline and patient journey maps
Review the causes of waiting tested against data
Decide which causes the cross-hospital findings detail

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Review findings and close the diagnostic
events.decision: Does the medical director accept the waiting-time findings as the basis for action?
agenda: Review the baseline, journey maps and causes behind the findings
Decide whether the findings are the basis for action
